repo.description: Name of the GitHub repository for the comments, e.g., user/repo

branch.description: Branch of the repository that has beaudar.json

label.description: Label of the issues created by Beaudar

theme.description: Beaudar look and feel when the page looks light, e.g., github-light, github-dark, or preferred-color-scheme

dark_theme.description: Beaudar look and feel when the page looks dark, e.g., with the dark or auto appearance of the theme. For example github-dark, github-dark-orange, classic-dark, dark-blue, icy-dark, or photon-dark

issue_term.description: The mapping between blog posts and GitHub issues, e.g., pathname, url, or title

issue_number.description: Configure Beaudar to load a specific issue by number
